chunking: paragraph packing per page (section heading forces new chunk; oversized paragraph split at sentences)
hypothesis: Keeping whole paragraphs improves coherence and evidence completeness with ~40% fewer chunks
notes: 599 chunks, mean 713 chars / 172 tokens; embed 150.6 s; coherence 1.8/2; unfiltered top-3 often mixes IP types (d14, t02, t03)

chunking: same chunks and vectors as B
filter: ip_type equality filter, only when the question supplies one (6/24 questions)
